page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmr9i.48xlarge is an ECS Bare Metal instance configured with the KVM hypervisor. The system is driven by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at 3.2 GHz, supplying 192 dedicated vCPUs. Memory provision stands at 1536.0 GB of RAM, yielding an allocation of 8.0 GB per core. This 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio places the server within the memory-optimized classification. Hardware accelerators are omitted, with GPU count at zero.

Networking capabilities feature a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating large data transfers between distributed infrastructure nodes. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Persistent local storage is listed as None, indicating reliance on remote network-attached volumes for persistent data operations.

The combination of 192 dedicated processing units and 1.5 TB of memory provides high resource density for massive enterprise environments. Given the hardware parameters, this server is suitable for in-memory databases, large caching systems, enterprise resource management software, and high-concurrency data processing that does not rely on local disk arrays or GPU compute.
